title: Reset Synchronizer Missing — Glitch on rst_n Pulse
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [META] gnt=4'bxxxx after short rst_n pulse; partial reset state
rtl:
always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  if (!rst_n) gnt <= 4'h0;  // rst_n pulse < 1 clk period causes partial reset
testbench: initial begin #50 force rst_n = 0; #1 release rst_n; end
expected_root_cause: The active-low reset rst_n is used asynchronously without a synchronizer; a reset pulse shorter than one clock period releases before the grant register can complete its reset, leaving gnt in a partially-reset garbage state.
description: An asynchronous rst_n pulse shorter than one clock period releases before the grant register can cleanly reset, causing gnt to land in a mid-reset garbage state.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [META] gnt=4'bxxxx after short rst_n pulse; partial reset state
success_log: Synchronized reset: gnt cleanly zero after rst_n pulse regardless of pulse width.
